title: BuilderForce workspace hooks
description: Directives the BuilderForce agent runs at lifecycle points of every run in this repository. Commit this file so everyone gets the same actions.

id.description: Stable name for the hook; shown to the agent when it fires.

markdownEnumDescriptions: The run is about to end. A `prompt` is handed to the agent once; a failing `command` holds the run until it passes (bounded).
Before a tool call. A failing `command` refuses the call and the agent sees why.
After a successful tool call. A failing `command`'s output is handed back to the agent with the tool result.
After the run has settled. `command` only; its result is ignored.

prompt.description: An instruction for the agent (stop hooks only), e.g. "Update README.md and DONE.md with the work completed in this session."

command.description: A shell command run in the workspace root. Needs your one-time approval per machine. Env: BUILDERFORCE_HOOK_EVENT, BUILDERFORCE_HOOK_ID, BUILDERFORCE_TOOL_NAME, BUILDERFORCE_TOOL_ARGS, BUILDERFORCE_CODE_CHANGED, BUILDERFORCE_TOUCHED_FILES.

tool.description: preTool / postTool only: "*", a tool name (e.g. "git_push"), or names joined with "|" (e.g. "write_file|edit_file").

when.description: stop / runEnd only: fire only on runs that changed code (default), or on every run.

blockOnFailure.description: False makes a command advisory: it runs and its result is ignored.
